title: Corn at the Store
lines: Meg wants to fix corn for Gran.
She runs to the store before it shuts.
The store has no more corn at all.
Meg is sad. What can she fix then?
Then Meg thinks of the corn at the farm.
Mom and Meg run a short path past thorns.
The corn stands tall next to the big barn.
Meg picks the best corn she can spot.
She fills a bag and they run back.
Meg and Mom get home before dark.
Gran grins and helps Meg cut the corn.

questions.ask: Why could Meg not get corn at the store?
questions.listenFor: The store had no more corn at all. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: What did Meg and Mom run past on the short path?
questions.listenFor: Thorns. It is one line, and it is the line most kids skim.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was glad she thought of the farm? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like getting the corn to Gran in time.
